about: Profile documents, their merge and the effective view, read by canoa-host (tests/profile.rs) and the app (app/test/profile_vectors_test.dart). Each layer is a TOML document; `effective` is the view both produce, or `error` the first refusal: its layer's index, a code, and for every code but parse the key it names. `sources` are AOS source strings held to what Canoa fetches. `overlays` are AOS overlays, each given as its files: the overlays refused whole, the view of their layers in composition order under an optional user layer, and the environment built from them over `host`, or the refusal.

merges.name: all six layers: a later layer wins per key, lists merge by name, a layer removes an entry

files.overlay.cfg:
priority = 300

[env]
TOOL_MODE = "read-only"
TOOL_CONFIG = { path = "conf/tool.toml" }
TOOL_TOKEN = { provider = "env", key = "TOOL_TOKEN", optional = true }
TOOL_URL = "${TOOL_HOME}/api"

[[paths]]
variable = "MANPATH"
path = "man"

[[mcp.servers]]
name = "docs"
transport = "stdio"
command = "tools/server"
args = ["--quiet"]
env = { MODE = "x", KEY = { provider = "env", key = "DOCS_KEY" } }
env_passthrough = ["HOME_DIR"]
timeout = 30

[[mcp.servers]]
name = "remote"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "http://docs.example/mcp"
headers_env = { Authorization = "DOCS_AUTH" }

not_applied: mcp.docs: it runs in the overlay's root, which Canoa does not set yet
mcp.remote.headers_env.Authorization: never sent over plain http to another host
